candidates.original_title: Automaticity of social behavior: Direct effects of trait construct and stereotype activation on action
candidates.description: Exposure to elderly-related words causes participants to walk more slowly
candidates.citation_sentence: Studies 1a and 1b use a paradigm developed by [4] to examine the behavioral consequences of an implicitly primed elderly stereotype.
candidates.notes: The prime main effect in Study 1a was not significant (p = .13), but the Self-Consciousness x Prime interaction was significant (p < .05). The combined analysis across both studies explicitly replicates Bargh et al. (1996).
